original_benchmark.notes: CWE-bench v2 public set (100 tasks, 91 CWEs) at upstream release 2.0.1. Distributed as native Harbor tasks in the gated Hugging Face dataset collinear-ai/cwe-bench; the upstream harness is Harbor, so any Harbor agent can run it. The agents listed are harnesses on the upstream leaderboard, which does not publish their versions; it also lists Antigravity without saying which interface.
CWE-bench v2 held-out set (150 tasks). Not released, so it cannot be adapted.

harbor_adapter.notes: Parity experiments have not been run yet, and the dataset is not registered yet. Task packages are copied verbatim from upstream; only the [task] identity in task.toml is set by the adapter.
